classification.difficultyReason: Infer missing dimensions from equality marks, distinguish the concave boundary from construction lines, and subtract both a rectangle and a semicircle.

content.prompt: For the figure shown below, use $\pi\approx3.14$ to find the approximate value of:

spec.description: Upright rectilinear boundary with a left-bulging semicircular indentation from the right. Top and bottom edges have matching double ticks. The two short right vertical edges and the two horizontal notch edges have matching single ticks. Ordinary source blue strokes are house black; the internal dashed diameter and centre retain semantic red. No shading.
spec.mathematics: Top edge 18 m; upper right vertical edge 5 m; semicircle radius 5 m. Four single-ticked edges are equal. Top and bottom edges are equal. The radius is horizontal and the internal diameter is vertical.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens, equality marks, radius, centre and internal dashed diameter are visible.

answer.short:
$91.7\text{ m}$

Add the straight boundary lengths and the semicircular arc; exclude the internal radius and diameter.
answer.worked:
The four single-ticked edges are each $5\text{ m}$. The total height is $5+2\times5+5=20\text{ m}$.

$$\begin{align*}L_{\text{arc}}&=\tfrac12\times2\pi\times5\\L_{\text{arc}}&=5\pi\text{ m}\\P&=18+18+20+4\times5+5\pi\\P&=76+5\pi\\P&\approx76+5\times3.14\\P&\approx91.7\text{ m}\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$270.75\text{ m}^2$

Subtract the rectangular notch and the semicircle from the outer rectangle.
answer.worked:
The outer rectangle is $18\text{ m}$ by $20\text{ m}$. The removed rectangular notch is $5\text{ m}$ by $10\text{ m}$, and the removed semicircle has radius $5\text{ m}$.

$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{outer}}&=18\times20=360\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{notch}}&=5\times10=50\text{ m}^2\\A_{\text{semicircle}}&=\tfrac12\pi\times5^2=\tfrac{25\pi}{2}\text{ m}^2\\A&=360-50-\tfrac{25\pi}{2}\\A&\approx310-\tfrac{25\times3.14}{2}\\A&\approx270.75\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
